text: 2012. Night map of South Asia, from the Persian Gulf on the left to Thailand on the right. Bright clusters mark cities: a very bright one in northern India near Delhi, several across the southern peninsula, Kolkata and Dhaka in the east, and Bangkok at the lower right. The Himalaya and Tibetan Plateau are dark and grey at the top. Sri Lanka is a dim island at the bottom.

2023. The same view as 2012. More thin lines of light link the cities, and a broad glow covers the eastern part of the Ganges plain. Many cities look brighter than in 2012, including Delhi, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Bangkok.

Change map, 2012 to 2023. The same view in dim colours. Purple marks places that look brighter in 2023 than in 2012, and orange marks places that look dimmer. Purple covers most of India, around cities and along roads, with a broad purple area in the east of the Ganges plain. Bangkok also looks brighter. Small orange patches appear in Pakistan.
